_meta.what: Port physics parameters for the three EP grain export gateways (R7). Curated compilation from published sources; every value carries source + year. provenance: published | assumed (assumed values are ALSO listed in data/ASSUMPTIONS.md).
_meta.shipping_year: 1 Oct - 30 Sep (Bunge Port Loading Protocols, effective 14 Oct 2025)

key_sources.ACCC2021: ACCC Final Determinations - Port Lincoln & Thevenard exemption assessment, 20 Jul 2021, https://www.accc.gov.au/system/files/Viterra%20Final%20Determinations%20for%20Port%20Lincoln%20and%20Thevenard.pdf
key_sources.BUNGE_PLP: Bunge Port Loading Protocols, effective 14 Oct 2025, https://www.viterra.com.au/dam/jcr:900fcacc-573b-41f7-8c6c-82723631e458/Bunge-Port-Loading-Protocols.pdf
key_sources.TPORTS_PLP: T-Ports Port Loading Protocols 2024/25, issued 21 Mar 2024, https://tports.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/12.INF_.10-Port-Loading-Protocols_2425_PUBLIC-ISSUE.pdf
key_sources.ESCOSA2019: ESCOSA Inquiry into bulk grain export supply chain costs, Final Report Jan 2019, https://www.escosa.sa.gov.au/ArticleDocuments/1076/20190129-Inquiry-BulkGrainExportSupplyChainCosts-FinalReport.pdf.aspx

storage_t.note: no newer public figure under Bunge

rail_receival.note: none since EP rail closure 31 May 2019

typical_season_shipped_mt.source: Viterra 2016 news (~1.5 Mt); 2022/23 1.8 Mt, drought 2024/25 >0.9 Mt (Stock Journal/Viterra statements, see CALIBRATION.md)

maintenance_shutdown.value: September (observed: stem lists Port Lincoln closed 1-30 Sep 2026; AIS shows near-zero berth visits Aug-Oct)
maintenance_shutdown.source: Bunge shipping stem 17 Aug 2026; AIS-derived vessel_calls.parquet

berth_stay_hours_median.source: derived from AMSA CTS AIS (vessel_calls.parquet), 190 cargo berth visits

approach.value: Yatala Channel 8.2 m; daylight berthing only without bow thrusters

other_commodities.note: AIS berth visits at Thevenard include non-grain vessels; grain share must come from stem/receivals

berth.value: 120 m wharf, 5.5 m berth draft, TSV only (no ocean vessels alongside)

tsv.value: MV Lucky Eyre: 87 m self-propelled self-discharging, 3,200 t/cycle (wheat), 12 kn

effective_loading_t_per_weather_working_.source: T-Ports exemption application quoted in ACCC2021 pp.33-34

anchorages.value: TP5 16.0 m, TP6 17.1 m declared; ~5.5 nm offshore

weather_limits.value: transshipment suspended above wind 21 kn / swell 2.5 m

max_vessel.value: Panamax; hatch-coaming height above waterline <= 14.5 m

notional_capacity_t_yr.note: ACCC best estimate for Lucky Bay alone (2020/21); 2024/25 PLP states 1.1 Mt combined Lucky Bay + Wallaroo sharing one TSV

observed_throughput.value: 0.36 Mt / 20 shipments Mar 2020 - May 2021; best month 67,000 t (Mar 2021); >3 Mt cumulative to Jul 2025

status_2026.value: closed for shipping 15 Aug - 31 Oct 2026 (maintenance); business listed for sale Jul 2025
status_2026.source: T-Ports shipping stem 5 Aug 2026; Grain Central Jul 2025
